long_biography.plain_text:
Sport gives Sheikh Mansoor bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum his clearest arena of public leadership. Elected president of the UAE National Olympic Committee for the 2024-2028 term, he also chairs the Dubai Sports Council. Across both bodies, his agenda centres on long-term athlete development, broad public participation, governance and partnerships that strengthen the UAE's sporting system.

His remit extends beyond sport. As chairman of the Dubai Ports and Borders Security Council, he leads coordination among customs, aviation, maritime and security agencies. He also chairs Dubai's Higher Committee for the Protection of the Rights of People of Determination, where the focus is accessible services, inclusion and institutional cooperation. Together, these roles define a public-service profile based on cross-agency leadership and broad institutional coordination.
